bloom.category.bloomlevelup.utility.name: Utility
bloom.category.bloomlevelup.combat.name: Combat
bloom.category.bloomlevelup.armor.name: Armor
bloom.category.bloomlevelup.misc.name: Misc
bloom.stat.bloomlevelup.armor.dodge.name: Dodge
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.utility.vein_mi: Break a whole connected ore vein at once (up to 64 blocks). Each block costs normal durability, and it stops before your pickaxe breaks. Sneak to skip.
Mine a whole ore vein in one go.

Most blocks: {veinMiningMaxBlocks} per vein
Durability: normal cost for every block
Break one ore with the right pickaxe: every connected block of the same ore breaks with it. Sneak while breaking to skip it.

It stops before your pickaxe would break.
It needs a pickaxe that can harvest the ore.
Fell a whole natural tree in one swing. Each log costs durability; logs you placed are never touched. Sneak to skip.
Fell a whole tree with one log.

Most logs: {timberMaxLogs} per tree
Durability: normal cost for every log
Chop a log of a natural tree with an axe: the whole tree comes down. Sneak while chopping to skip it.

Logs you placed are never touched, so your builds are safe.
It stops before your axe would break.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.utility.shovel_: Your Utility stats are stronger while using a shovel; Yield turns into treasure finds.
Your Utility stats are stronger with a shovel, and digging can turn up treasure.

With a shovel: +{shovelMasteryBonus:pct} Efficiency and Preservation
Treasure chance per natural dug block: {excavationTreasureBaseChance:pct} + {excavationTreasureChancePer100Yield:pct} per 100 Yield

Dig dirt, sand, gravel and the like with a shovel. Your Yield counts {shovelMasteryBonus:pct} more toward treasure, and what you find depends on where you dig (desert, beach, swamp, mountains, forest, the Nether).
Blocks you placed never give treasure.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.utility.growth_: Crops around you grow much faster while you hold a hoe.
Crops around you grow much faster while you hold a hoe.

Range: {growthAuraRadius} blocks around you, {growthAuraHeight} up and down
Pulse: every {growthAuraIntervalTicks:sec}
Crops: {growthAuraChance:pct} chance per pulse to grow a stage
Other plants (cactus, cane, berries, saplings): {growthAuraRandomTicks} growth ticks per pulse
Hold a hoe in either hand near your farm.
Only works while the hoe is in your hand.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.utility.master_: Each shear has a coin-flip chance to leave the target shearable again. Uses double durability.
Shearing can leave the animal shearable again right away.

Chance: {masterShearingChance:pct} per shear
Extra durability: +{masterShearingExtraDurability} per shear
Shear sheep, mooshrooms, snow golems or anything else shearable.
Every shear costs the extra durability, lucky or not.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.utility.triple_: Each catch rolls the fishing loot three times. Uses triple durability.
Every catch rolls the fishing loot several times.

Loot rolls: {tripleCatchRolls} per catch
Extra durability: +{tripleCatchExtraDurability} per catch
Fish as usual. Fish, junk and treasure all take part in every roll.
Every catch costs the extra rod durability.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.armor.fitting_a: A full armor set grants a Light, Medium or Heavy style bonus.
Wearing a full armor set gives you a style bonus that matches its weight.

Light (leather, chainmail, turtle): 10% backup dodge roll, 12% less fall damage
Medium (iron, gold): 15% less damage, axes disable your shield for {mediumShieldDisableRatio:pct} as long
Heavy (diamond, netherite): 30% less damage, +50% knockback resistance
Fill all four armor slots. Your style is the average weight of the pieces: mixed sets land on whichever style is closest.

With any slot empty you get no style at all.
Heavy's knockback resistance shrinks if you already resist knockback, so it never goes past 100%.
Medium and Heavy reductions don't work on damage that ignores Resistance.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.armor.protein.d: Eating meat slowly and permanently raises your maximum health.
Eating meat permanently raises your maximum health.

Gain: +1 health (half a heart) per 20 meat meals
Most it can add: +20 health (10 hearts)
Eat meat: raw or cooked beef, pork, chicken, mutton, rabbit and rabbit stew all count.

Refunding it, or a Bloom+ reset of Armor, starts your meal count over.
Switching builds keeps it while either build owns Protein!.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.armor.iron_skin: You always have the protection of Resistance I.
Damage taken: -20% (its own layer, after armor)
Nothing to do: it's always on while it's switched on.
Damage that ignores Resistance (falling into the void, /kill and similar) isn't reduced.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.armor.brace.des: Crouch still or raise a shield to gain Resistance II until you move (knockback doesn't count). Once it ends, it needs 10 seconds before it can brace you again.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.armor.brace.det: Plant your feet to take much less damage.
Crouch and stand still, or raise a shield, while on the ground. The shield icon next to your health bar lights up gold while you're braced and greys out while it recharges.

Moving or jumping ends it (getting knocked back doesn't).
It doesn't work in mid-air.
Damage that ignores Resistance isn't reduced.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.armor.parkour.d: A chance to completely ignore fall damage.
A chance to land any fall without a scratch.
Nothing to do: every fall that would hurt you rolls it.
When the roll fails you take the whole fall.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.armor.elemental: Take half damage from fire, freezing, lightning and drowning.
Fire, cold, lightning and drowning hurt you half as much.
Damage taken: -50% from fire, lava, freezing, lightning and drowning
Nothing to do: it's always on while it's switched on.
Magic, explosions and melee aren't elemental.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.armor.thick_blo: Poison and Wither wear off twice as fast.
Poison and Wither wear off twice as fast.
Nothing to do: the effects land already shortened.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.armor.vibranium: Damage taken: -30% from swords and axes
Nothing to do: hits from anything holding a sword or axe are reduced, players and mobs alike.
A thrown weapon or a punch isn't a blade.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.armor.reflect.d: A chance to deflect, or even catch, incoming projectiles.
Incoming projectiles can bounce off you, or be caught.

Catch chance: 10% (the arrow goes into your inventory)
Deflect chance: 25% (it bounces away)
Together: about 32% of projectiles never hurt you
Nothing to do: every arrow, trident or other projectile that hits you rolls.
Infinity arrows and mob-thrown tridents are stopped, but not kept.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.armor.rebound.d: A chance to throw part of a melee hit back at the attacker.
Melee hits you take can be thrown back at the attacker.

Chance: 15% per melee hit that hurts you
Thrown back: 50% of the hit (before your armor)
Nothing to do: it rolls whenever something hits you in melee.
Blocked hits and projectiles don't rebound.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.armor.unyieldin: A chance to shrug off negative effects as they are applied.
A chance to shrug off harmful effects as they land.
Nothing to do: every harmful effect rolls as it's applied.

Effects from food you choose to eat always land.
A few effects are never shrugged off (the bloomlevelup:unyielding_ignored tag).
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.armor.last_brea: Survive a killing blow. Gets less reliable each time within a short window.
Survive a killing blow, less reliably each time.
Nothing to do: when a hit would kill you, it rolls. The chances reset once the window passes without another attempt, or when you die.
It can't save you from damage that ignores invulnerability (the void, /kill).
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.armor.castle_of: When Last Breath saves you, become briefly invincible. Recharge by resting in a bed.
When Last Breath saves you, you become briefly invincible.

Invincible for: {castleOfStoneTicks:sec}
Recharge: rest in a bed for {castleOfStoneRestTicks:sec}
It triggers by itself on a Last Breath save. Sleep, or lie in a bed for a few seconds, to recharge it.

Needs Last Breath first.
Once per recharge: a second save before you rest gives no invincibility.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.armor.absorb.de: Your armor soaks up part of the damage you take, at the cost of its durability.
Your armor soaks up half of the damage you take, paying for it with durability.

Moved to armor: 50% of the damage left after all reductions
Durability cost: 1 per point moved, to one random armor piece
Nothing to do: wear damageable armor.

A piece that can't pay breaks, and what it couldn't pay is simply lost.
With no damageable armor on, nothing is absorbed.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.armor.titan_hid: With no armor worn, your innate Defense doubles and you move faster, but get knocked back further.
Fight with no armor on: your skin becomes the armor.

Innate armor: +2, then your Defense armor doubles
Movement speed: +50%
Fall damage: -70%
Knockback taken: ×2
Take off every piece of armor (all four slots empty).

One piece of armor turns it all off.
You're knocked back twice as far while it's on.
bloom.result.conflict: That conflicts with a Major you own. Use 'swap' to trade it in:
bloom.result.required_by_owned: These would be refunded with it (right-click it in the hub to confirm):
bloom.result.refund_disabled: That refund is switched off on this server (Majors: use the tab's reset button).
bloom.result.at_level_cap: That category is already at the level cap.
bloom.result.investment_locked: XP Investment unlocks after reaching the level cap in this category.
bloom.result.cooldown: Not yet: that reset is still cooling down.
bloom.result.stat_refund_locked: Stat points can be taken back once this category reaches level 100.
bloom.result.build_locked: The second build unlocks when any category reaches level 100.
bloom.command.info.header: %s — Major Levels: %s available (%s earned, %s spent) · Bloom+ %s
bloom.command.reset.confirm_hint: Bloom+ resets one category to level 0 and refunds its Majors (in both builds), for +1 bonus Major Level per 50 levels. Invested points, mastery and claimed milestones are kept. Run '/bloom bloomreset <category> confirm' to proceed.
bloom.command.admin.waits.on: Bloom waits are on: the tab reset button waits 20 minutes, switching builds 2 minutes.
bloom.command.admin.waits.off: Bloom waits are off: tab resets and build switches can be used any time.
bloom.command.reset.done: Bloom+ #%s complete. %s Major Levels refunded, %s bonus Major Levels awarded.
bloom.stat.bloomlevelup.misc.wisdom.name: Wisdom
bloom.stat.bloomlevelup.misc.speed.name: Speed
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.full_swe: Sweeping attacks deal the full damage of your main hit.
A sword's sweep hits the mobs around your target for the full attack damage of your main hit, not vanilla's 1 damage.

Sweep damage: 1 + 100% of your hit (vanilla: 1)
Works with: swords (every melee weapon with Batter Up!)
Swing a sword at full strength while standing on the ground, without sprinting and without a jump crit. Everything within reach of your target takes the sweep.

Vanilla's sweep rules still apply: no sweep on crits, sprint hits or half-charged swings.
Sweeping Edge adds nothing on top; the sweep is already at its maximum.
Better Combat's swords hit every mob in their arc, and get weaker the more they hit. Full Sweep takes that away: every mob takes the whole hit.
Sword hits finish off enemies already at 30% health or lower (bosses at 10%).
Once an enemy is low enough, your next sword hit finishes it.

Kills at: {executeThreshold:pct} health or less
Bosses: {executeBossThreshold:pct} health or less
Works with: swords

Hit a mob or player that is already at or under the threshold while holding a sword: it dies on the spot and counts as your kill. The hit that first takes it under the line doesn't finish it; the next one does. Sweeps and your own splash damage count too.

The hit has to land and do damage first.
An Execute kill doesn't splash Overkill damage.
Bosses (the bloomlevelup:bosses tag) need to be much lower.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.charge_a: Hold the weapon-skill key (V) with an axe to charge a swing for double damage. It can still crit. A charged swing costs 2 durability.
Hold the weapon-skill key with an axe to charge your next swing.
Hold V with an axe until the meter fills, let go, then swing at full strength within a second. The charged hit can still crit, and both multipliers stack.

A half-charged swing wastes the charge.
The charge is gone after 1 second if you don't swing.
Every charged swing costs extra durability.
Letting go plays a heavy overhead slam instead of the next swing of the combo, and it lands with a shockwave. The charge waits for the swing's wind-up.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.armor_br: Axe hits damage the target's armor durability.
Axe hits grind down the target's armor.

Armor wear: {armorBreakRatio:pct} of the damage you really dealt, rounded up
Applies to: every armor piece the target wears
Works with: axes
Hit anything wearing armor with an axe: a player, a zombie in armor, a piglin. Every worn piece loses durability on each hit.

Only real damage counts: a hit that does nothing breaks nothing.
It wears armor down; it doesn't lower the target's armor value until a piece breaks.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.guarante: Axe attacks always crit, but deal 2 less base damage.
Every full-strength axe hit is a critical hit, at the cost of some base damage.

Base damage: -{guaranteedCriticalPenalty} on axes
Crit multiplier: your Critical stat (×1.5 with no points)
Works with: axes
Swing an axe at full strength; no jumping needed. A jump crit is still one crit, not two.

The damage penalty is always on while you hold an axe, even for half-charged swings that don't crit.
Through Copycat, bow and crossbow arrows count as fully drawn crits.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.marksman: Fully drawn, long-range shots deal extra damage.
Fully drawn shots hit harder the further they travel.

No bonus up to: {marksmanStartDistance} blocks
Full bonus at: {marksmanFullDistance} blocks
Full bonus: +{marksmanMaxBonus:pct} damage
Works with: bows
Draw your bow all the way and hit something far away. The bonus climbs evenly from the start distance to the full distance.

Half-drawn arrows get nothing.
Distance is measured from you to the target when the arrow hits.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.piercing: Arrows pass through enemies and keep flying.
Your arrows go straight through enemies and keep flying.

Pierces: {piercingShotLevel} mobs (like Piercing {piercingShotLevel})
Works with: bows
Just shoot. Each arrow can pass through several mobs in a line.
A Piercing enchantment doesn't add to it; the higher of the two is used.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.straight: Your arrows fly straight with no drop.
Your arrows fly in a straight line with no drop.

Straight flight: up to {straightShotMaxTicks:sec}
Works with: bows
Aim exactly where you want to hit, at any range.

An arrow that hits nothing in that time vanishes.
They still slow down with distance, like normal arrows.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.reinforc:
Extra damage: +{reinforcedShotDamage} per arrow
Works with: crossbows
Fire a crossbow. Every arrow, Multishot ones included, gets the bonus.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.assault_: Load a 16-shot magazine and fire it rapidly before reloading.
Your crossbow loads a whole magazine and fires it one shot per click.
Load the crossbow as usual: it keeps loading until the magazine is full or you run out of ammo. Then each click fires one round.

Every round uses up its ammo, unless Crossbow Infinity or Rainbow saves it.
Once the magazine is empty you reload from scratch.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.unrestri: Sneak while releasing a trident to Riptide anywhere, rain or not, without the enchantment.
Sneak while you let go of a charged trident to launch yourself. No water or rain needed, and no enchantment.

Letting go without sneaking throws the trident as usual.
A trident that already has Riptide uses its own strength.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.lightnin: Trident hits send three sparks to nearby enemies, each bouncing on through up to three of them.
Trident hits throw sparks of lightning between nearby enemies.
Hit an enemy with a trident while others stand nearby. The sparks leave together, each to a different enemy (nearest first), then keep jumping to enemies they haven't shocked yet.

It needs at least one other enemy in range; alone, nothing happens and the cooldown doesn't start.
With few enemies around, sparks bounce back between them.
Press the weapon-skill key (V) with a trident to call lightning where you aim. Costs durability.
Call lightning down wherever you aim.

Range: {lightningSummonRange} blocks
Durability cost: {lightningSummonCostRatio:pct} of the trident's max per strike
Cooldown: {lightningSummonCooldownTicks:sec}
Works with: tridents
Hold a trident and press the weapon-skill key (V). The bolt lands on the block or mob you're looking at.

A trident too worn to pay the cost won't call it, so it never breaks.
Lightning can set things on fire and turn mobs (villagers, pigs, creepers) like real lightning.
Your bare fists hit like a weapon.
Extra damage: +{brawlerDamage} with an empty main hand
Fight with nothing in your main hand.
Anything in your main hand turns it off, even a block or food.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.combo.de: Each clean punch adds a little damage to the next, until you stop attacking.
Clean punches build up extra damage for the next ones.

Per clean punch: +{comboPerHit} damage
Most it can add: +{comboCap} damage
Resets after: {comboResetTicks:sec} without attacking
Works with: bare fists
Keep landing full-strength punches. The HUD meter shows the stacks and how long they last.

Half-charged punches don't add a stack.
Stop attacking for a few seconds and it drops to nothing.
Every mob a full-strength hit lands on adds a stack, so wide swings build Combo fast.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.disarm.d: Punches can knock the item out of a target's hand.
Punches can knock the held item out of a target's hand.

Chance: {disarmChance:pct} per punch
Works with: bare fists
Punch a mob or player that's holding something. A mob drops it on the ground (it can't grab it back for 3 seconds); a player drops their main-hand item.
Only your main punch rolls, not sweeps or splash damage.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.slash.de: Fully charged sword hits have a 50% chance to make the target Bleed. Your sweeps can too.
Strong sword hits can make the target Bleed.

Chance: {slashChance:pct} per fully charged hit
Bleed: {bleedTicks:sec}, 1 damage every second
Works with: swords
Land fully charged sword hits; the mobs your sweep catches can bleed too. A Bleed refreshes when it lands again, but never stacks.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.batter_u: Every melee weapon, and your fists, can sweep.
Every melee weapon, and your fists, can sweep like a sword.

Sweep damage: 1 + your sweeping ratio × your hit
Works with: every melee weapon and bare fists
Swing at full strength while standing on the ground, without sprinting or jump-critting. With Full Sweep the sweep hits for the full damage.

Needs a Sword Major first.
The same rules as a sword's sweep: no crit, no sprint, full strength, on the ground.
Swords already sweep; for them it changes nothing.
Better Combat already lets every weapon hit its whole arc. Batter Up! instead takes away its penalty for hitting several mobs, for everything but swords (Full Sweep does swords).
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.aura_swo: After 5 hits, three sweep waves roll out around you, out to 4 blocks.
Every few clean hits, three sweep waves roll out around you.
Land main hits with a melee weapon or your fists. On the last one the waves go out at about 1, 2 and 3 blocks, pushing mobs away. Each mob is hit by one wave at most.

Needs a Sword Major first.
Wave damage is your attack damage only: enchantments don't add to it.
Sweeps and other splash hits don't count toward the hits needed.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.heavy_ha: Charge Attack works with every melee weapon (hold the weapon-skill key). A charged swing costs 2 durability.
Charge Attack works with every melee weapon and your fists.
Hold the weapon-skill key (V) until the meter fills, let go, then swing at full strength within a second.

Needs an Axe Major first.
Without Master of Arms it can't be owned with Catch! or Lightning Summon (they share the weapon-skill key).

Letting go plays a slam instead of the next swing of the combo (two-handed weapons slam with both hands, fists throw an uppercut), and it lands with a shockwave. The charge waits for the swing's wind-up.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.catch.de: Tap the weapon-skill key (V) to throw a sword, axe, dagger or knife like a trident. It always comes back, and so do your tridents. Thrown daggers and knives hit 50% harder. Each throw costs 3 durability; a weapon too worn for that stays in hand.
Throw your sword, axe, dagger or knife like a trident. It always comes back.

Tap the weapon-skill key (V) to throw the weapon in your main hand. It flies back to you after hitting. Your tridents also always return, as if they had Loyalty III. With Death From Above, a throw that drops hits harder the further it falls.

Needs a Trident Major first.
Without Master of Arms it can't be owned with Heavy Hands or Charge Attack.
A weapon too worn to pay the durability stays in your hand.
A thrown weapon's damage doesn't include your Power or Strength.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.master_o: Use Catch!, Heavy Hands, Charge Attack and Lightning Summon all together.
Lets you own the combat Majors that normally rule each other out, and unlocks combos between them.
Allows together: Catch!, Heavy Hands, Charge Attack, Lightning Summon
Buy it, then buy the others. With several of them on the same key, holding the weapon-skill key charges and letting go uses the combo. The combos you own are listed below.
Combos need all of their Majors owned and switched on.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.death_fr: Every melee weapon hits harder the further you fall.
Every melee weapon hits harder the further you fall.

First 3 blocks: +4 damage per block
Next 5 blocks: +2 per block
After that: +1 per block
Fall onto a target and hit it on the way down.

Needs an Axe Major first.
It doesn't save you from the fall damage.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.predator: Keep hitting the same target to ramp up your damage.
Keep hitting the same target to ramp up your damage.
Focus one target with main hits or projectiles. The HUD meter shows your stacks.

Switching targets starts over.
Sweeps and splash damage neither use nor build stacks.
Better Combat swings hit several mobs at once, so any mob keeps your stacks going, not just one target.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.bloodlus: Kills build up a burst of offensive momentum.
Kills build up momentum that boosts all your damage.
Keep killing. Every kill adds a stack and restarts the timer; the HUD meter shows both.
Let the timer run out and every stack is gone at once.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.overkill: Extra damage from a kill splashes onto nearby enemies.
Damage beyond what a kill needed splashes onto nearby enemies.

Splash: {overkillRatio:pct} of the extra damage
Targets: up to {overkillMaxTargets} (split evenly)
Range: {overkillRadius} blocks
Kill something with more damage than it had left. The extra spreads to the nearest enemies around it.
Execute kills and Overkill's own kills don't splash again.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.first_st: Your opening hit on an unhurt target deals bonus damage.
Your opening hit on an unhurt target deals more.
Hit something that's still at full health, with any weapon, arrow or sweep.
Once it's hurt at all (by anyone), the bonus is gone.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.crossbow: Crossbows don't use up normal arrows.
Crossbows don't use up normal arrows.

Free ammo: normal arrows
Works with: crossbows
Keep at least one arrow in your inventory and fire away.

Tipped and spectral arrows and fireworks are still used up.
Free arrows can't be picked back up.
Pick one weapon Major you own and use its effect with every compatible weapon.
Spread one weapon Major you own to every weapon it can work with.
Copies: one weapon Major at a time
Shift-click one of your owned weapon Majors in the hub to copy it; shift-click it again to stop.

The copied Major keeps all its costs and drawbacks.
Switching the source Major off pauses the copy.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.combat.one_and_: Bridges your Combat build to your pet. Coming with the Pet system.
Bridges your Combat build to your pet.
Coming with the Pet system: right now it does nothing.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.misc.iron_stoma: Raw, rotten and poisonous food is safe to eat and at least as filling as cooked chicken.
Raw, rotten and poisonous food is safe and filling.
Food floor: {ironStomachNutrition} hunger and {ironStomachSaturation} saturation (cooked chicken)
Eat rotten flesh, spider eyes, raw meat or fish, pufferfish or poisonous potatoes: their bad effects never land, and they fill you at least as much as cooked chicken.
Food that's already better keeps its own values.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.misc.selective_: Milk and vegetables clear only your negative effects.
Milk and vegetables clear only your harmful effects.

Cleanses: every harmful effect
Keeps: every good effect
Drink milk, or eat carrots, potatoes, beetroot (and soups) or golden carrots.
Apples, golden apples and berries don't cleanse.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.misc.xp_insuran: Keep half the experience you'd normally lose on death.
Get part of the experience a death would destroy back when you respawn.
Nothing to do: on respawn the insured experience comes back. The orbs you drop are separate, so pick them up too.
With keepInventory on, nothing is lost, so nothing is returned.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.misc.second_ser: Eat any food, even on a full stomach.
Eat any food, even on a full stomach.
Use food at any hunger level.
Extra food past a full bar only tops up saturation.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.misc.water_to_w: New timed effects last at least 10 minutes, good and bad alike. Switching it off cuts the effects it stretched to 2 minutes.
Every timed effect you get lasts at least 10 minutes, good or bad.

Shortest duration: {waterToWineMinTicks:min}
When switched off: stretched effects drop to {waterToWineCutTicks:min}
Nothing to do: new timed effects are stretched as they land.
Bad effects are stretched too. Switch it off to cut them short.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.misc.overdose.d: Re-applying an effect you already have raises its level, up to 2 above the source. Beacons and conduits don't stack.
Re-applying an effect you already have makes it stronger.
Most extra levels: +{overdoseMaxBoost} above the source
Drink or apply the same effect again while it's still on you: it climbs one level each time, up to the limit. More of it then just refreshes it.

Beacons and conduits don't stack.
A stronger effect simply replaces a weaker one, as usual.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.misc.hoarders_p: A 9-slot pocket (chest button in your inventory) that keeps its contents through death, travel and resets. No shulker boxes or bundles inside.
A small pocket that keeps its contents through anything.
Open it with the chest button in your inventory. It keeps its items through death, travel between worlds and resets.
No shulker boxes or bundles inside.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.misc.stack_over: Anything that stacks holds up to 300 per slot in your inventory and Hoarder's Pocket. Chests and other containers keep their normal limits.
Bigger stacks in your own inventory.
Stack size: up to {stackOverflowMax} per slot
Anything that stacks fills up to the new size in your inventory and Hoarder's Pocket.
Chests and other containers keep their normal limits, so moving a big stack into one splits it.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.misc.rune_embed: Embed enchanted books in 5 rune slots (book button in your inventory). Slots 1-4 work while you wear no armor; slot 5 works bare-handed with sword enchantments. Books aren't used up; no curses or duplicates.

Rune slots: 5
Slots 1-4: armor enchantments, active with no armor on
Slot 5: sword enchantments, active bare-handed
Open the rune slots with the book button in your inventory and put enchanted books in them.

Books aren't used up, but curses and duplicates aren't allowed.
Putting on any armor turns slots 1-4 off; holding an item turns slot 5 off.
bloom.major.bloomlevelup.misc.rainbow.de: Bows and crossbows don't use up any arrows or fireworks (you still need one).
Bows and crossbows don't use up any ammo.
Free ammo: every arrow and firework

{stormCallBolts} bolts fall one after another in a ring {stormCallRadius} blocks around where you aim.
